portInfo.description: Melbourne is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.

climate.description: Temperate climate with four distinct seasons

politics.visaRequirements: Visa or ETA required for all visitors. ETA available online for many nationalities.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. ETA or visa required for all non-citizens.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Station Pier — Station Pier, Port Melbourne VIC, Australia
gettingThere.distanceToCity: About 3 km to the CBD via tram Route 109 or taxi. Public access to parts of the pier can be limited on ship days — follow Ports Victoria notices and your cruise line shuttle guidance.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Melbourne CBD / Federation Square precinct — tram 109.
St Kilda / beach — opposite direction; allow extra transit.
Laneways / coffee culture — walk once in CBD.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Check Ports Victoria’s public closure calendar before planning a pier walk; ship days often close visitor access.
